request.objective: Start at https://www.target.com/. Search for a job in Miami, Florida, in Human Resources on target.

response.result:
Started at target.com, went through to Target's careers job search, and ran a search for Human Resources work around Miami, Florida.

Search page: https://corporate.target.com/careers/job-search?currentPage=1&query=Human%20Resources&lat=25.76417&lon=-80.18459&location=Miami%2C%20FL
Filters showing on the results page: "Human Resources" and "Within 25 Miles Miami, FL".
The page's own count: 6 results for “Human Resources”.

The six openings it listed:

1. Executive Team Leader Human Resources (Assistant Manager HR) | North Miami, FL — 16901 Miramar Pkwy, Miramar, FL — Store Leadership, Full-time, $64,000 – $128,000
2. Target Security Specialist — 1750 W 37th St, Hialeah, FL — Store Hourly, Part-time
3. Store Executive Intern (Store Leadership Intern) – Miami – Starting Summer 2027 — 249 NW 6th St, Ste 120, Miami, FL — Internships, Part-time
4. Target Security Specialist — 14075 Biscayne Blvd, North Miami Beach, FL — Store Hourly, Part-time
5. Target Security Specialist — 3251 Hollywood Blvd, Hollywood, FL — Store Hourly, Part-time
6. General Merchandise Team Leader — 16901 Miramar Pkwy, Miramar, FL — Store Hourly, Full-time, $21.50 – $23.50/hr

Worth knowing: the search behaves as a keyword/category match rather than a strict role filter — only the first listing is a dedicated HR job, while the other five are security, internship and merchandising roles the site returned inside the Human Resources search around Miami. If you want strictly HR work, the Executive Team Leader HR position (listed for North Miami but based at 16901 Miramar Pkwy, Miramar) is the match.
